transaction.sec2_path: C-reference, no SEC2 reset, unchanged TRANSCFG, portal verification, 3-second MMIO-quiet window

provenance.adaptation: Header-free NVRTC kernels, PyTorch current context/stream, CUDA driver launches, packed-half exact checks, interleaved modes.

instruction_issue.scope: Native instruction issue rate and bounded exact-result checks; not application speedup or endurance certification.

sanitization: Allowlisted scientific fields only. Operator identity, GPU UUID, local absolute paths, device addresses, absolute timestamps, timezone and raw OS/config/event dumps excluded. Public upstream URLs retained for provenance.
